claim.title: Finite-d correction of the C2 overparam risk approximation: power-law decay d^-alpha at fixed gamma=0.5 (generated variant of C2)
claim.statement: For beta=e_1, sigma=0.1, gamma=0.5, n=d//2, the relative error e(d)=|R_mc-R_th|/R_th of the min-norm interpolant parameter risk (R_mc = mean over T=4000 trials of ||beta_hat-beta||^2, beta_hat=X.T@solve(X@X.T+1e-12*I_n,y); R_th=(1-gamma)||beta||^2+sigma^2*gamma/(1-gamma)=0.51) follows e(d)=C*d^-alpha over d in {100,200,400,800} with OLS log-log slope alpha in [0.25,1.25], fit R^2>=0.8, and MC se_e < 25% of e(d) at each d.
claim.test_plan: Self-contained numpy script, fixed seed, no scipy.special. Main test: beta=e_1, sigma=0.1, gamma=0.5, n=d//2, T=4000 trials per d, d in {100,200,400,800}. Per trial: X~N(0,I_{n,d}), y=X@beta+0.1*N(0,1), beta_hat=X.T@np.linalg.solve(X@X.T+1e-12*I_n,y) (pinv fallback on LinAlgError), accumulate r=||beta_hat-beta||^2 and sum_beta_hat. Per d: R_mc=mean(r), se_r=std(r)/sqrt(T), e(d)=|R_mc-0.51|/0.51, se_e=se_r/0.51, coef=<sum_beta_hat/T, beta>. Main fit: OLS of log10(e) on log10(d) over the 4 d values -> alpha, se_alpha, R2. POSITIVE CONTROL (mandatory): identical pipeline (same MC statistic ||beta_hat-beta||^2, same fitter) in the underparam regime gamma=2 (n=2d), OLS beta_hat=pinv(X)@y, where the EXACT finite-d expected parameter risk is sigma^2*d/(n-d-1)=0.01*d/(d-1) (Wishart inverse-trace identity), so its relative deviation from the paper's Claim-2 approximation sigma^2/(gamma-1)=0.01 is exactly 1/(d-1), i.e. true power-law slope alpha=1; fit the same way over the same 4 d values. control_pass iff alpha_ctrl in [0.85,1.15] AND R2_ctrl>=0.9 AND se_e<30%*e at all control d. If the control fails the measurement is void. SUMMARY_JSON fields: per-d {R_mc, se_r, e, se_e, coef}; alpha, se_alpha, R2; control {alpha_ctrl, R2_ctrl, control_pass}; n_trials=4000; wall_s; status. Plot main and control e(d) vs d (log-log) with fitted lines (fig.png). NOTE: if any main-test d violates se_e<0.25*e, raise T to 16000 for ALL d and refit ONCE, then decide (this is the one permitted retry; record the T used in notes). Expected wall-clock: main 4d x 4000 trials (n<=400 solves) ~1-3 min single core; control similar; total <10 min.
claim.success_criterion: supported iff control_pass AND alpha in [0.25,1.25] AND se_alpha<=0.25 AND R2>=0.8 AND se_e<0.25*e at all 4 d. falsified iff control_pass AND (alpha<0.25 OR R2<0.8): no systematic d-decay at fixed gamma, confirming C2's error_decays_with_d=false as real, not MC noise. inconclusive iff control fails OR se_e>=0.25*e at any d after the single T=16000 refit. Auxiliary, recorded not gating: if |coef-gamma|/gamma>0.02 at any d, attribute the risk deviation to the C8 bias-coefficient mechanism and note it.
claim.rationale: C2 round 3 measured max_rel_err_R at d=50/150/300 (0.0875/0.0129/0.0333, T=200) and reported error_decays_with_d=false, but those are grid maxima over gamma at uncontrolled gamma, so the d-dependence at fixed gamma is unmeasured. C8 (control passed) showed the bias coefficient deviates from gamma (2.9% at gamma=0.1, d=150), so the source of the risk error (bias vs variance term) is open. A fixed-gamma slope fit with an exact analytic positive control (underparam Wishart identity => true slope alpha=1) turns C2's noisy grid-maxed comparison into a measurable exponent, or falsifies asymptotic d-improvement at fixed gamma. Director edits vs proposal P3: R_th corrected 0.52->0.51 (0.52 is the PREDICTION-risk value; the accumulated statistic is parameter risk ||beta_hat-beta||^2), and d=800 made mandatory (4-point log-log fit: 2 dof, robust to one noisy point; wall-clock still <10 min).
